title: Test Rows for a Data Stream You Cannot Reach

steps.prompt: An architect built a Direct Access data stream that feeds a DLO, a DMO, and a Flow that writes to CRM. The upstream source belongs to another team and will not be available for three weeks. How should the architect get test rows into the DMO to validate the Flow?

options.label: POST sample payloads with the Ingestion API into the Direct Access stream's existing DLO
options.rationale: A DLO belongs to the stream and connector that created it, so the Ingestion API can write only to its own streams' DLOs, not to one a Direct Access stream owns.

options.label: Point the Flow at fixture records in a CRM custom object until the source is available
options.rationale: The Flow would read a different object, so the DMO mapping and the Data 360 trigger path it depends on go untested.

options.label: Add a temporary Cloud Storage or file upload stream whose DLO maps to the same DMO
options.rationale: Each connector ingests into the streams it owns, but several streams can map into one DMO. A temporary stream mapped to the same DMO exercises the DMO-to-Flow path without touching the Direct Access source.
